dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Ha! A Knight feels at home wherever the wind blows.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: And it's not like we'll never get to go home. There will be other Knights coming from Mondstadt to relieve us.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: What's one more round of duty after the long expedition we've already been through?
